leaks.title: Money Leaks
leaks.subtitle: Smart insights on recurring expenses
leaks.howItWorksIntro: We scan your spending for patterns that quietly drain money. A leak is flagged when:
leaks.howItWorksBullet1: • A merchant is paid 3+ times — frequent, avoidable spending
leaks.howItWorksBullet2: • A recurring charge suddenly increases in price
leaks.howItWorksBullet3: • A subscription is billed but hasn't been used in 45+ days
leaks.neverCountedTitle: What's never counted as a leak
leaks.neverCountedText: Essential and important payments are always excluded — bills, EMIs/loans, insurance, medical/health, education, rent, taxes, and investments or savings. Anything you tag as Other Expense (money sent to another person, or moved between your own accounts) is excluded too. Only unnecessary or extra spending is considered.
leaks.allClearSubtitle: No spending leaks detected. Your finances look healthy.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: LifeWise is built to be privacy-first. This page explains what data we collect, what permissions we request, how we use data, and how we keep it secure.
privacy.dataCollectionBody:
• Account data (optional): name, email/phone if you create an account.
• Reminder data: reminders you create, schedules, and completion status.
• Usage analytics (optional): app performance and feature usage to improve reliability.
privacy.permissionsBody1: LifeWise may request access to read SMS only to detect bill and financial reminder messages (for example: electricity, mobile recharge, subscriptions, and bank alerts). This helps us identify due dates and amounts so you don't miss critical payments.
privacy.permissionsBody2: We do not use SMS data for advertising, profiling, or selling to third parties.
privacy.dataUsageBody:
• To create reminders and send notifications.
• To generate insights like life score and reports.
• To support Family Hub features you enable.
privacy.securityBody: We apply industry-standard security practices (encryption in transit, access controls, and least-privilege). If we store data, we aim to minimize what's collected and retain it only as long as needed to provide the service.
